Entry Level
 SHARE
Junior Software Developer – Print & Packaging

Company: PackOS / Calyx Containers
Location: West Valley City, Utah (On-site)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience Level: Entry-Level / Junior
Compensation: Competitive, based on experience

About PackOS

PackOS is building the operating system for the print and packaging industry.

Our mission is to connect the entire packaging production process from customer requests and artwork submission to quoting, prepress, manufacturing, quality control, and order fulfillment, through intelligent software and automation.

PackOS is being developed alongside Calyx Containers, a vertically integrated packaging manufacturer with real-world production capabilities in digital printing, labels, flexible packaging, and rigid containers.

Unlike traditional software companies, we build and test our technology directly inside an operating manufacturing facility.

About the Role

We are looking for a Junior Software Developer with hands-on experience in printing, packaging, or prepress to help build the next generation of manufacturing software.

This is a unique opportunity for someone who understands how a print shop or packaging operation works and wants to transition into software development.

You don't need to be an experienced software engineer. We are looking for someone with a technical mindset, basic programming knowledge with AI tools like Codex/ Claude Code, Antigravity, and a genuine interest in building software that solves real manufacturing problems.

You will work closely with experienced developers, production operators, and company leadership to build practical software solutions that improve how packaging is designed, quoted, manufactured, and delivered.

You will also use modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate your work while learning professional software engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

Software Development

Develop and improve features within the PackOS platform.
Build user interfaces, dashboards, and internal tools.
Assist with coding, debugging, testing, and maintaining applications.
Work with APIs, databases, and manufacturing system integrations.
Use AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code and other modern development environments.
Review, test, and validate AI-generated code with guidance from senior developers.

Printing & Packaging Automation

Help automate artwork intake, preflight checks, quoting, and production workflows.
Translate real-world print shop operations into software requirements.
Support integration with print MIS, ERP, and manufacturing equipment.
Assist in developing tools for production tracking, machine data collection, and quality control.
Work directly with operators to understand production challenges and test software improvements.

Collaboration & Learning

Work alongside the software development team to build and release new features.
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and product testing.
Learn modern web development tools and software engineering practices.
Troubleshoot issues directly on the manufacturing floor.
Document technical processes and software functionality.
Required Qualifications

We are primarily looking for someone who combines print or packaging industry experience with foundational software development skills.

Hands-on experience in commercial printing, labels, packaging manufacturing, or prepress.
Basic programming knowledge, demonstrated through coursework, personal projects, professional experience, or self-directed learning.
Familiarity with at least one programming language, such as JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python.
Basic understanding of how software applications, databases, or APIs work.
Ability to troubleshoot technical problems and learn new systems.
Strong attention to detail and willingness to work directly with manufacturing teams.
Interest in AI, automation, and modern software development.

A computer science degree is not required. Relevant industry experience, demonstrated technical ability, and a strong willingness to learn are more important.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with any of the following is a plus, but not required:

Print & Packaging

Digital printing, especially HP Indigo equipment
Flexographic printing and label converting
Flexible packaging production
Adobe Illustrator and print production workflows
Dielines, color separations, PDF preflight, and artwork preparation
Print MIS systems such as LabelTraxx or Radius
Manufacturing ERP systems such as NetSuite

Software & Technology

JavaScript / TypeScript
React and Node.js
SQL and PostgreSQL
REST APIs and system integrations
Git and GitHub
Claude Code or other AI coding assistants
Industrial automation, PLCs, or equipment data collection
What Makes This Opportunity Different

Learn software development inside a real factory.

You will have direct access to production equipment, manufacturing operators, and real-world workflows while helping develop the software that supports them.

Work with modern AI technology.

Our development approach incorporates AI-assisted programming, workflow automation, and intelligent software systems.

Build technology with immediate impact.

Rather than working on abstract projects, you will help solve actual manufacturing problems and see your software used in production.

Grow into a software engineering career.

You will work with experienced engineers and develop practical skills in full-stack development, manufacturing technology, and AI-driven applications.

Benefits
Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience
Health insurance benefits
401(k) retirement plan
Professional development and mentorship
Hands-on exposure to advanced manufacturing and AI technology
Opportunity for career growth as PackOS expands

 

MORE ABOUT US:

Our team is composed of bright, hardworking, creative, and highly motivated individuals looking to make an impact on the world. We seek like-minded colleagues who share our values and want to apply their experience, energy, and enthusiasm to help grow and scale a dynamic business in a rapidly expanding industry. The Calyx Containers culture fosters the personal and professional growth in a challenging and rewarding environment. We operate at a fast pace, demand high personal standards, and offer everyone the opportunity to contribute, skill-build, and develop their talents.

Benefits and Perks offered to full time employees:
-Flexible Paid Time Off
-Comprehensive benefits offerings including: Medical (with company-funded HRA), Dental, Vision, Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance, Life Insurance, Headspace Care Mental Health support...all effective the first day of the month following hire.
-401(k)
-Ability to make an immediate impact
-Monthly team meetings and frequent social events

An ideal Calyx candidate looks like:
-Has experience in the cannabis and/or packaging industry
-Thrives in a fast-paced environment
-Handles ambiguity with a positive attitude
-Rolls up their sleeves to help their team

How success is measured at Calyx:
First 30 days spent getting to know the company and our team!
Ability to make an immediate impact - we’re growing quickly and want you to help cultivate that!
Living our core values:
--X-treme Ownership
--Be Quick, But Don’t Hurry
--Sustainability Is Multi-Dimensional
--We Are Square: Quality Does Not Cut Corners
--Customer Is The Only Boss
--Earn Success Every Day
--The Biggest Failure Is The Failure To Ask For Help
--Better Together: Cultivate An Inclusive Environment

Calyx Containers is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe strongly in fair hiring practices and in creating a welcoming environment for all team members. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Diversity drives innovation; inclusion drives success. We believe a multitude of approaches and ideas enable us to deliver the best results for our workforce, workplace, and customers. We are committed to fostering a culture where all employees can share their passions and ideas so we can tackle the toughest challenges in our industry and pave new paths to limitless possibilities.
Calyx is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@calyxcontainers.com. (Please note that applications should not be emailed to this address).
